purpose: Prospective acceptance contract; recorded before integrated candidate or held-out comparisons.

corpus.independence: Parameterized variants are not independent linguistic samples; report unweighted family results alongside case totals.

measurement_classes.scripted-production-path: Real application orchestration and deterministic compiler with scripted model responses and fixture-only tools. Contract/integration evidence, not model routing accuracy.
measurement_classes.resident-inference-production-path: Actual already-resident Ling inference and real application orchestration; all tool execution synthetic. Requires recorded serialized resource window.
measurement_classes.training: Independent synthetic demonstrations, development selection, reloadable checkpoint smoke gate; no old or new held-out prompt/failure-derived training.

activation_targets.existing_regressions: No new failures in complete isolated Python gate.
activation_targets.latency: Preserve exact-path model-call count (zero). Flexible planner has 2.5 second default total deadline, at most one repair; report p50/p95, timeout and clarification rates separately. Compare warmed latency to refreshed production baseline; do not equate a fast abstention with success.
activation_targets.evidence: Exact final SHA mechanical checks, same-head configured CI, independent release audit, scoped independent synthetic QA.
activation_targets.meaning: Targets are not achieved results. An unqualified candidate remains disabled; code-only tests cannot establish activation readiness.

report_metrics: exact effective arguments including explicit dates and defaults
excluded/unauthorized offered vs executed tools separately
process and device memory with attribution limits
comparison_rules: Freeze integrated candidate and model/runtime identities before opening held-out results.
Do not tune candidate or training data using held-out prompts, outputs or failure-derived variants. Later fixes require a new independently authored hold-out for fresh generalization claims.
Run candidate comparisons under matched clocks, timezone, source fixtures and bounded concurrency.
Distinguish model inference, deterministic rendering and simulated tool execution in every result.
Do not treat old prototype scores or Claude menu/reachability scores as production exact-call accuracy.
No production configuration changes, native tools, outbound actions, personal logs, model unload/reload or deployment.
resource_status: No inference/training reservation yet; offline development only.

supplemental_guard_contract.request_argument: Permit an additional registered view_messages strict_match=True only when sealed gold omits it, literal nonempty query matches exactly, and all other effective arguments match with types preserved. Explicit gold guard values remain authoritative.
supplemental_guard_contract.query_scope_guard: Separate required metric for applicable query-bearing records requests; missing/false/nonboolean/unsupported guard cannot receive success. Report applicability explicitly.
supplemental_guard_contract.guarded_end_to_end: Combine request_argument with applicable query_scope_guard and original source/exclusion/effect/runtime/fact/coverage/recovery/completion checks. Preserve original end_to_end separately.
supplemental_guard_contract.runtime_evidence: Argument scoring cannot prove execution behavior. Separate synthetic actual view_messages tests cover matching and no-match paths, exact limit, date precedence and unavailable source.
supplemental_guard_contract.path_metadata: Finite intent_disposition describes routing path only; it does not prove model inference occurred.
